objective.statement: Address the agreed R13/R14 MECE and feedback audit gaps with existing records and proportionate checks.
non_goals: Exhaustive control pairing, new control taxonomy, or claims of unexecuted CI/deployment.

success_measures.definition: Known audit bypasses rejected and required Windows/Linux CI checks complete.
success_measures.target: Zero accepted bypass fixtures; all applicable CI filesystem defenses executed.
success_measures.method: python -I tools/validate_package.py --require-fs-tests --project-trace 04_ASSURANCE/package-trace.json; compare deployed outcome before closure.

requirements.acceptance: Implement the seven agreed themes; keep deployment and outcome pending until independently observed.

evidence_refs: snapshot:sha256(sorted(path + NUL + file_sha256 + LF)); excludes MANIFEST and this trace to avoid self-reference

observations.finding: Vertical/horizontal audits accepted missing proof bindings and incomplete feedback; R13 simplification left the package validating example work rather than its own improvement.

feedback.rationale: Apply the agreed amendments in seven independently checked themes; preserve fifteen controls and reuse existing records.
feedback.next_action: Review/apply .validation/mece-series/07-package-self-review.cumulative.patch; record actual commit/PR and required CI run refs, deployment, then measured outcome before CLOSE.
feedback.revisit_trigger: Any rejected regression fixture, skipped applicable CI filesystem defense, invalidated evidence or later target miss returns work to the affected theme.
